description: This file defines the ProspectList class, which is a PHP class extending SugarBean, representing prospect lists in the SuiteCRM application. It includes properties for prospect list fields, relationship handling, query methods for listing and exporting data, and relationship management functions.

classes.name: ProspectList
classes.description: Represents a prospect list in SuiteCRM, providing methods for CRUD operations, query building, and relationship management with prospects, contacts, users, and accounts.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the prospect list, specifically its name.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to retrieve prospect lists with optional ordering and filtering, including custom joins.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query for exporting prospect list records with optional ordering and filters.

methods.name: create_export_members_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL union query to retrieve export data for various related modules (Leads, Users, Contacts, Prospects, Accounts) linked to the prospect list.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Updates relationships between the prospect list and prospects, contacts, or leads based on class properties.

methods.name: set_prospect_relationship
methods.description: Associates multiple related IDs with the prospect list for a specific link type.

methods.name: set_prospect_relationship_single
methods.description: Associates a single related ID with the prospect list for a specific link type.

methods.name: clear_prospect_relationship
methods.description: Removes specific prospect relationships from the list.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Placeholder method for marking relationships as deleted (empty implementation).

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Placeholder for filling additional list fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in extra detail fields, including entry count.

methods.name: get_entry_count
methods.description: Returns the number of prospects associated with the list.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view display, including entry count.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a SQL WHERE clause for searching prospect lists based on a query string.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides parent save method to persist the ProspectList object.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the prospect list and its related prospects as deleted.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates interface implementation; returns true for 'ACL'.
